decision: No publication-worthy finding has survived. The user goal remains unmet; search is not exhausted; continue substantive discovery. TMEM266 remains shelved.
premature_stop: R8 bounded pilot completion was incorrectly treated as campaign-level stopping grounds. This correction does not weaken scientific standards or convert pending/failed gates into findings.

settled_questions.question: Direct perfusion/endothelial measurement contrast
settled_questions.result: Two author-labelled EMC observations in a165-case kinetic cohort, individual linkages currently request-only or unlinked. No paired endothelial count-area comparison. Prior treatment exclusion differs between studies; fitted IVIM/DCE parameters are not direct flow, oxygen or endothelial density.
settled_questions.reopening: Explicit case-to-assay mapping and an independently useful new comparison with compatible controls, units and uncertainty.

settled_questions.question: Oxygen measurement and marker calibration
settled_questions.result: One author-labelled EMC in2026 FMISO cohort and four in2017 tissue study remain unlinked to individual measurements/core assessability. Older oxygen-electrode and FMISO cohorts have unresolved case histotypes and donor reuse. Published marker discordance and older FMISO limitations are prior art.
settled_questions.reopening: Source-supported donor/condition/measurement links and genuinely useful contrast; no manufactured spatial/core matching or equivalence of proxy assays.

settled_questions.question: Circulating tumor-specific burden measurements
settled_questions.result: R3 evaluations reused. Genuine newer assays preserve missing EMC/serial crosswalks, larger untyped cohorts and request-only records. FoundationOne Liquid letter is192 baseline patients, not48. Baseline tumor fraction prognostic prior art is not an EMC serial monitoring discovery. Nondetection without validated target and sensitivity is not absent shedding.
settled_questions.reopening: Authenticated same-donor serial EMC analyte and burden mapping, defined assay limits and a valuable unanswered comparison.

settled_questions.question: Public phosphoproteomic source eligibility
settled_questions.result: Author-linked portal lists four CPTAC cohorts, not the1998-tumor MASTER/CATCH/INFORM clinical dataset. Nineteen schema fields are exposed, but no EMC patient or kinase measurements were inspected. Source/software metadata is not clinical measurement coverage.
settled_questions.reopening: Explicit public metadata/condition linkage and direct site/total protein measurements meeting unchanged RET prior-art and assay controls; no numerical stage authorized now.

coverage: Pending suitable public evidence remains pending and blocks promotion. Evaluated rosters, source-access failures and published measurements are bound in packets; none proves universal exhaustion.
validation: Fourteen source commits and exact compact export bytes verified; normal fast preflight exits0, pytest skipped. Hosted pytest failures remain unresolved. Repository checks are not scientific replication or publication clearance.
